brief_title: MK0653A (Ezetimibe (+) Simvastatin) Compared to an Approved Drug (Atorvastatin) for the Treatment of High Cholesterol (0653A-051)(COMPLETED)
official_title: A Multicenter, Double-Blind, Randomized, Parallel Group, 6-Week Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Ezetimibe/Simvastatin Combination Tablet Versus Atorvastatin in Patients With Hypercholesterolemia

primary_outcomes.measure: Plasma LDL-C averaged across all doses after 6 weeks

brief_summary: This study is to assess the safety and efficacy of an investigational drug as compared to an approved drug to reduce specific cholesterol levels.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Elevated cholesterol

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unstable medical conditions or significant heart problems within 3 months prior to first study visit.
